reason: All exercised behavior is within the listed subset: multiple from clauses produce ordered Cartesian products over arrays and toStream results; record and nested tuple typed bindings, where and let clauses feed list-valued select results. The assertions check lengths, ordered fields, tuple-filter equality, open-record rest fields, record-to-map type tests and record values. No query binding-pattern restriction is stated; the wildcard-only restriction applies specifically to destructuring assignment statements, which this case does not use. Both invoked array langlib methods are explicitly supported.
test_design_notes: io:println supplies assertion instrumentation; its import alone does not make this a feature case.
The foreach blocks intentionally break after their first iteration while checking the remaining result elements by index.
